title: Hayden Cade Return Filing stays listed with no authored choice after Wolf-Winter
body:
After **Wolf-Winter completes**, Albany Station still lists **Hayden’s Cade Return Filing** with:

> No authored choice is currently available in this journey state.

That is authoring-layer copy on a leftover lead, not a player action. Testers hit it at the end of an otherwise finished chapter.

This wave (seed-base `1800000000`, store `ai-runs/playtest/sessions-wave-20260831`, build `d8d03f8ce620999c7d7666cff6bfbcd9d4bbeefc`): **19** completed interviews named it (`bugs[]`, mostly S1; a few S0). The prior grok-4.6 MCP wave (`1700000000`) had **21** independent mentions of the same leftover filing. Typical `where`: Albany Station Quarter after Wolf-Winter / Dawn Under Albany Seal / after End.

Not a duplicate of MIC-33–MIC-40 (yard blocks, Cade-as-manual, LAY DC, cattle alarm, paperwork, Jamie loft, duplicate $0). Related-but-done `e24b759193c0cd8c` was the Rowan **charter-backlog** lead on the Albany **opening** (“talk to Rowan” then the same engine string). Hayden is a **post-quest** dead lead after the farm is already won.

Fix: when Wolf-Winter is complete, either author the Hayden filing choice or hide/close that lead. If it must stay visible, replace the engine sentence with world-facing copy (Hayden has no more questions tonight) instead of “authored choice / journey state.”
area: Albany Station Hayden Cade Return Filing
